description: Create a new budget account (on-budget or off-budget). Returns the new account ID so transactions can target it right away.

initialBalance.description: Opening balance in human amounts (e.g. 1500.50, not cents). Creates the "Starting Balance" transaction.

offBudget.description: Whether the account is off-budget (tracked but outside the budget, e.g. a loan or investment). Defaults to false.

name: create_account
